name: 29710 · Clover, SC
findings: ZIP 29710 (Clover) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29710 (Clover) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29710 (Clover) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list membership
observations.text: No hobby and sports organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.
